item.title: Pope Leo tells Argentina’s Trump ally Milei that leaders must know limits of power
item.description: Pope Leo on Sunday urged Argentina to safeguard its democracy in a closely watched speech to President Javier Milei, a close ally of US President Donald Trump, during the second stop of a 12-day South American tour by the Catholic leader. Leo told Milei, who has said he will seek re-election next year, that leaders must seek to better the lives of all their citizens and know the limits of their power. item.title: Iran executes 3 more men over January protests, judiciary says
item.description: Iranian authorities executed three men on Sunday on charges linked to January 2026 protests, the judiciary said, after what rights groups described as an unfair trial. Norway-based Iran Human Rights (IHR) said the hangings at dawn of Hassan Divband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh in the city of Karaj outside Tehran brought the number of men hanged over the January protests to at least 39 and warned many more were at risk. item.title: Tens of thousands of Dutch protesters take to Amsterdam streets to support Palestinians
item.description: Tens of thousands of people dressed in red thronged the streets of Amsterdam on Sunday to denounce ongoing violence against Palestinians in Gaza, carrying signs reading “Stop the Genocide”. item.title: Will China’s slow and steady moon landing plan be a safer bet than the US’?
item.description: China’s full dress rehearsal for its crewed moon landing would be tougher on schedule but safer than Nasa’s cheaper bet on commercial landers, a US space policy analyst said after the rival powers updated their lunar plans within a week of each other.
